Tooltip.Armor: Armor reduces all damage received to HP from a single source by an amount equal to its rating, unless stated otherwise (such as Burn and AP). Armor can reduce damage to 0, has a cap of 4, and is resolved after the Exposed status and before Resistance.
Tooltip.Evasion: Evasion determines the target number required to hit a target with ranged or melee attacks.
Tooltip.EDefense: E-Defense determines the target number required to hit a target with Tech Attacks and other electronically guided systems (such as Homing).
Tooltip.Overshield: Overshield: Temporary extra hit points that absorb damage before armor and HP.
Tooltip.Burn: Burn: Persistent damage received at the start of each round until mitigated (typically via Stabilize action).
Tooltip.Speed: Speed: the number of spaces the mech can move with a single Move action.

Overcharge.Name: Overcharge
Overcharge.Desc: Gain an extra Quick Action at the cost of escalating Heat.

Stabilize.Name: Stabilize
Stabilize.Desc: Stabilize systems: Clear Heat/Exposed or reload loading weapons.

FullRepair.Name: Full Repair
FullRepair.Desc: Rest/Full repair: Reset structure/stress/heat, replenish repair capacity.

Deploy.Prompt: Click on the map to position the token for: {name} (or ESC / Right-Click to cancel)
Deploy.NotFound: Deployable sheet ("{name}") not found in world or compendiums.

Tags.StatusToggleTooltip: Toggle the {cond} status effect on this token.

Warning.NoTarget: You must target at least one token first.
Warning.PermissionDeniedGM: You do not have permission to modify status effects on this token without an active GM.

Move.Name: Move
Move.Desc: On their turn, characters can always move spaces equal to their SPEED, in addition to any other actions. This is called a standard move to distinguish it from movement granted by systems or talents. A character only counts as moving if they move 1 or more spaces. Characters can move into any adjacent space, even diagonally, as long as the space isn’t occupied by an obstruction.

Boost.Name: Boost
Boost.Desc: When you BOOST, you move at least 1 space, up to your SPEED. This allows you to make an extra movement, on top of your standard move. Certain talents and systems can only be used when you BOOST, not when you make a standard move.

Hide.Name: Hide
Hide.Desc: When you HIDE, you obscure the position of your mech in order to reposition, avoid incoming fire, repair, or ambush. To HIDE, you must not be ENGAGED and you must either be outside of any enemies’ line of sight, obscured by sufficient cover, or invisible. If you HIDE while meeting one of these criteria, you gain the HIDDEN status.

Search.Name: Search
Search.Desc: When you SEARCH, you attempt to identify hidden characters. To SEARCH in a mech, choose a character within your SENSORS that you suspect is HIDDEN and make a contested SYSTEMS check against their AGILITY. Once a HIDDEN character has been found using SEARCH, they immediately lose HIDDEN and can be located again by any character.

Prepare.Name: Prepare
Prepare.Desc: When you PREPARE, you get ready to take an action at a specific time or when a specific condition is met (a more advantageous shot, for example). As a quick action, you can PREPARE any other quick action and specify a trigger. Until the start of your next turn, when it is triggered, you can take this action as a reaction.

QuickActivation.Name: Quick Activation
QuickActivation.Desc: When you ACTIVATE, you use a system or piece of gear that requires either a quick or full action. These systems have the QUICK ACTION or FULL ACTION tags. You can ACTIVATE any number of times a turn but can’t ACTIVATE the same system more than once unless you can do so as a free action.

FullActivation.Name: Full Activation
FullActivation.Desc: When you ACTIVATE, you use a system or piece of gear that requires either a quick or full action. These systems have the QUICK ACTION or FULL ACTION tags.

Disengage.Name: Disengage
Disengage.Desc: When you DISENGAGE, you attempt to extricate yourself safely from a dangerous situation, make a steady and measured retreat, or rely on your mech’s agility to slip in and out of threat ranges faster than an enemy can strike. Until the end of your current turn, you ignore engagement and your movement does not provoke reactions.

SkillCheck.Name: Skill Check
SkillCheck.Desc: When you make a SKILL CHECK, you undertake an activity that isn’t covered by other actions but has a clear goal and is sufficiently complex to require a roll (full action).

Ram.Name: Ram
Ram.Desc: When you RAM, you make a melee attack with the aim of knocking a target down or back. To RAM, make a melee attack against an adjacent character the same SIZE or smaller than you. On a success, your target is knocked PRONE and you may also choose to knock them back by one space, directly away from you.

QuickTech.Name: Quick Tech
QuickTech.Desc: When you use QUICK TECH, you engage in electronic warfare, countermeasures, and other technical actions, often aided by a mech’s powerful computing and simulation cores. Each time you take this action, you choose an option from the QUICK TECH list.

Scan.Name: Scan
Scan.Desc: When you SCAN, you use your mech’s powerful sensors to perform a deep scan on an enemy. To SCAN, choose a character or object within SENSORS and line of sight, then ask the GM for one of the following pieces of information...

Eject.Name: Eject
Eject.Desc: You can also EJECT as a quick action, flying 6 spaces in the direction of your choice; however, this is a single-use system for emergency use only – it leaves your mech IMPAIRED. Your mech remains IMPAIRED and you cannot EJECT again until your next FULL REPAIR.

ShutDown.Name: Shut Down
ShutDown.Desc: When you SHUT DOWN, your mech powers completely off and enters a rest state. Your mech takes the SHUT DOWN status: all heat is cleared, as is EXPOSED; any cascading NHPs return to normal; conditions caused by tech actions end; the mech gains IMMUNITY to tech actions; the mech is STUNNED indefinitely until BOOT UP.

FullTech.Name: Full Tech
FullTech.Desc: When you use FULL TECH, you perform multiple tech actions or a single, more complex action. To use FULL TECH, choose two QUICK TECH options or a single system or tech option that requires FULL TECH to activate.

ImprovisedAttack.Name: Improvised Attack
ImprovisedAttack.Desc: When you make an IMPROVISED ATTACK, you attack with a rifle butt, fist, or another improvised melee weapon. To make an IMPROVISED ATTACK, make a melee attack against an adjacent target. On a success, they take 1d6 kinetic damage.

Dismount.Name: Dismount
Dismount.Desc: When you DISMOUNT, you climb off of a mech (full action). When you DISMOUNT, you are placed in an adjacent space.

Skirmish.Name: Skirmish
Skirmish.Desc: When you SKIRMISH, you attack with a single weapon. To SKIRMISH, choose a weapon and a valid target within RANGE (or THREAT) then make an attack. In addition to your primary attack, you may also attack with a different AUXILIARY weapon on the same mount. SUPERHEAVY weapons cannot be fired in a SKIRMISH.

Grapple.Name: Grapple
Grapple.Desc: When you GRAPPLE, you try to grab hold of a target and overpower them. To GRAPPLE, choose an adjacent character and make a melee attack. On a hit: both characters become ENGAGED; neither character can BOOST or take reactions; the smaller character becomes IMMOBILIZED and moves when the larger party moves.

Bolster.Name: Bolster
Bolster.Desc: When you BOLSTER, you use your mech’s formidable processing power to enhance another character’s systems. To BOLSTER, choose a character within SENSORS. They receive +2 Accuracy on the next skill check or save they make between now and the end of their next turn.

LockOn.Name: Lock On
LockOn.Desc: Choose a character within SENSORS. They gain the LOCK ON condition. Any ally can consume LOCK ON to gain +1 Accuracy on their next attack.

SelfDestruct.Name: Self Destruct
SelfDestruct.Desc: When you SELF DESTRUCT, you overload your mech’s reactor in a final, catastrophic play (quick action). At the end of your next turn, or at the end of one of your turns within the following two rounds (your choice), your mech explodes causing a BURST 2 explosion that deals 4d6 explosive damage and annihilates your mech.

Barrage.Name: Barrage
Barrage.Desc: When you BARRAGE, you attack with two weapons, or with one SUPERHEAVY weapon. To BARRAGE, choose your weapons and either one target or different targets – within range – then make an attack with each weapon.

Stabilize.Name: Stabilize
Stabilize.Desc: When you STABILIZE, you enact emergency protocols to purge your mech’s systems of excess heat, repair your chassis where you can, or eliminate hostile code. Choose to cool your mech or mark 1 REPAIR. Additionally, choose to reload LOADING weapons, clear burn, or clear a condition.

BootUp.Name: Boot Up
BootUp.Desc: You can BOOT UP a mech that you are piloting as a full action, clearing SHUT DOWN and restoring your mech to a powered state.

Brace.Name: Brace
Brace.Desc:
Trigger: You are hit by an attack and damage is rolled.

Effect: You count as having Resistance to all damage, burn, and heat from the triggering attack, and until the end of your next turn, all other attacks against you are made at +1 difficulty.

Invade.Name: Invade
Invade.Desc:
Make a tech attack against a target within Sensors. On a success, the target takes 2 Heat and you choose an Invade option:

Fragment Signal: You feed false information, obscene messages, or phantom signals to your target’s computing core. They become IMPAIRED and SLOWED until the end of their next turn.

Overwatch.Name: Overwatch
Overwatch.Desc:
Trigger: A hostile character starts any movement (including Boost) inside one of your weapons’ THREAT.

Effect: When a weapon is triggered through Overwatch, immediately use that weapon to Skirmish against the triggering character as a reaction, before they move.

EnableHUD.Hint: If enabled, the HUD will automatically open when you select a token.
